_readme: TEMPLATE. Copy to production.databases.json (gitignored) and fill in the
READ-ONLY credentials for each production environment.
These are for a SQL CLIENT (sqlcmd, SSMS, Azure Data Studio) used to
investigate real data. They are NOT the running application's connection:
Helpers/DevelopmentSqlGuard.cs refuses to start a Development process that
points at a non-local server, and it is meant to.
Allowed against production: SELECT, schema metadata, query plans, comparing
NEVER without a written override from the maintainer: INSERT, UPDATE,
DELETE, MERGE, TRUNCATE, ALTER, DROP, CREATE, EF migrations, EXEC of any
procedure that may mutate state, or any automated test that writes.
See docs/ENVIRONMENTS.md for the full standard.
